Unmatched devices receive DefaultDevice; unmatched ASUS products receive ASUS XGMobile path. Neither establishes model support. Unknown GPD Win Max 2 CPU defaults to 8840U; other unmatched CPU branches may return DefaultDevice.
Vendor-interface VID/PID sets differ from physical controller attachment selectors. HID and XInput factories have separate interface/mode rules.
An axis profile does not prove a physical IMU; Windows/legacy/serial sensor presence is discovered dynamically. Controller-specific sensor producers are identified separately.
MSI/Steam Deck firmware tables and default/nearest matches do not prove universal firmware compatibility. BIOS-sensitive EC addresses need independent target-device acceptance.
